title: Prefix rescue (gold first entity-value binding) on iGSM at 300M, 520M and 1.2B
status: registered before any run of this extension; see REGISTRATION_4SCALE.json for the timestamp and SHA256
request: User task list of 2026-11-21, item 2: evaluate the prefix rescue on the iGSM main-experiment checkpoints of 300M, 520M and 1.2B (both sources, 4 blocks, 682 steps), evaluation only.
existing_version: E3b (130M, the original E1 runs, 12 blocks): e3_rescue.py and e3_rescue_summary.py; results E3B_SUMMARY.json.

deviation_from_the_request.fact: The final checkpoints of the iGSM main-experiment runs at 300M, 520M and 1.2B no longer exist on any server (they were deleted after scoring).
deviation_from_the_request.user_decision: 2026-11-21: do not rerun the same blocks; run a different seed, whose base results can then be averaged with the earlier blocks.
deviation_from_the_request.consequence: The prefix evaluation is run on new training runs of order seed 20261023 (rotations k0 and k2), 2 blocks per scale and source instead of the 4 blocks named in the request. The larger scales then have the same six blocks as iGSM 130M (order seeds 20261021, 20261022, 20261023 x rotations k0, k2), and the base (no-prefix) results of the new blocks pool with the existing four.

new_training_runs.protocol: the iGSM main experiment of each scale unchanged: 682 steps, the selected learning rates, tf32, same data, probes and evaluation steps

evaluation_identical_to_130m.procedure: for each complete cell, load its final full checkpoint, append the gold solution's first sentence ('Define <entity> as a; so a = ...') to every probe prompt, generate the rest greedily with the evaluation settings (batch 64, 768-token budget including the prefix, Answer-line stop), and score prefix + continuation with the official validator; paired with the cell's saved final-step outputs
evaluation_identical_to_130m.counts: rescued (base wrong, with prefix right) and broken (base right, with prefix wrong)

primary_quantities.per: scale, source and optimizer, at every level
values: gap to G1 closed by the prefix (share)
Muon's extra gain: (prefix - base) of Muon minus (prefix - base) of AdamW
primary_quantities.interval: two-way cluster bootstrap over families and blocks, as e3_rescue_summary.py; with two blocks the block dimension is narrow and the interval is reported with the number of blocks

outputs.result_file: E3B_SUMMARY.json with the existing structure; keys prefixed with the scale, e.g. '<scale>/A/G2/0'
outputs.package: MuonPaperData_<date>_E3B_<scale>.zip: result JSON, per-item outputs, per-checkpoint tables and training curves of the new runs, analysis scripts, this file, SHA256 list. No user, institution or host name in paths or contents.

execution.weights: final checkpoints are kept until the prefix evaluation, the dW spectra and the export of block k0-o23 are done
